description: Tangle's README stills and GIFs (a port of its tools/media.cjs). Put this file at the game's root, serve the game, then: darkroom shoot media.json

setup.js: window.__dr = { EYE: 1.62, TRI: [-19.6, 2.9, -3.6], look(from, at) { const dx = at[0] - from[0], dz = at[2] - from[1], dy = at[1] - this.EYE, h = Math.hypot(dx, dz); return [Math.atan2(-dz, -dx), Math.atan2(-dy, h)]; }, pose(x, z, yaw, pitch) { const g = window.__tangle; if (g.state.card) g.card(null); g.pose(x, z, yaw, pitch); } }
